title: Loans with member names
statementMd:
For loans made in January 2024, show the loan id, member name and loan date.

Expected columns: `id`, `name`, `loan_date`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Join `loans` to `members`, filter on the date.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT l.id, m.name, l.loan_date FROM loans l JOIN members m ON m.id = l.member_id WHERE l.loan_date >= '2024-01-01' AND l.loan_date < '2024-02-01';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
